source-backed.label: Source evaluation — counted evidence
source-backed.meaning: A dated, numbered CITE or conformance-suite count is published for this exact capability.

source-evaluation.label: Source evaluation
source-evaluation.meaning: Runnable and inspectable from public server trunk today; no aggregate test count is published for this exact capability yet.

partial.label: Partial coverage
partial.meaning: Documented, operation-level coverage and gaps exist, but no aggregate test count is published for this exact capability yet.

preview.label: Preview
preview.meaning: Implemented and disclosed, but pre-GA: disabled by default, opt-in only, and may change.

proof-pending.label: Proof pending
proof-pending.meaning: No public evidence artifact is published for this exact capability yet.

capabilities.summary: Create, update, and delete features via Esri FeatureServer applyEdits and open protocols (OGC API Features, WFS-T, OData).

capabilities.statusNote: Documented, operation-level coverage; no aggregate CITE-style count published for this operation set yet
capabilities.summary: Serve queryable feature layers through Esri's GeoServices REST FeatureServer surface, side by side with OGC API Features.
gaps: Query parameters, attachments, relationships, and versioned workflows vary by dataset — validate before cutover.

capabilities.statusNote: Documented, operation-level coverage; no aggregate CITE-style count published for this operation set yet
capabilities.summary: Serve dynamic map exports, identify, legends, and layer definitions through Esri's GeoServices REST MapServer surface.
gaps: Dynamic export, identify, legends, and renderer parity vary by service — validate before cutover.

capabilities.statusNote: 137/137 assertions pass in the applicable profile
capabilities.summary: Serve and query vector features through the OGC API Features standard, the open-protocol counterpart to Esri FeatureServer.
gaps: Write support through this surface is WFS-T/OGC API Features Part 4; Esri FeatureServer applyEdits is tracked separately under Editing.

capabilities.statusNote: 199/199 assertions pass in the applicable profile
capabilities.summary: Render map images through the OGC Web Map Service 1.3 standard.

capabilities.summary: Serve pre-rendered map tiles through the OGC Web Map Tile Service 1.0 standard.

capabilities.statusNote: 16/16 assertions pass in the applicable profile
capabilities.summary: Serve vector tile sets through the OGC API Tiles standard for client-side rendering.

capabilities.statusNote: Live public STAC root; not part of the published 952-assertion CITE count
capabilities.summary: Publish a SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) for imagery and raster collections, queryable via STAC API search.
gaps: STAC is a supported surface outside the published 952-assertion CITE snapshot; no separate STAC conformance count is published yet.

capabilities.statusNote: Documented forward/reverse/suggest coverage; no aggregate test count published for this operation set yet
